question: In what order of effects may the offering behave when taken up in the presence of sacrifice and pacified by weapons and winds?
premises: When taken up in the presence of sacrifice, the offering may behave in order.
It may tremble, or when stiffened it may flow, or it may be dissolved.
In that process it is pacified by weapons and winds.
inference: In order, when taken up in the presence of sacrifice, the offering may tremble, or when stiffened may flow, or may be dissolved, and is pacified by weapons and winds.
uncertainties: Weapons and winds are technical here and not explained by this verse alone.
Causal link between the three effects and pacification remains open.
plain_english: In order, when the offering is taken up in the presence of sacrifice, it may tremble, or when stiffened it may flow, or it may be dissolved, and it is pacified by weapons and winds.
